name: Install OpenCode CLI
description: Installs the OpenCode CLI onto the system PATH so it is available to the remote user. Uses the official installer (https://opencode.ai/install). By default installs the latest release; pass 'version' to pin a specific release. The binary is installed to /usr/local/bin so it works for any shell in the container without modifying rc files.

version.description: OpenCode release version to install, e.g. 1.0.180, or 'latest'.
